content:
TEMPTATION ||| Let the blade slip from my fingers onto the ground. ||| “Let’s see what happens if I don’t answer.”  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, pulling my hand away from his. ||| “I won’t play your game in front of them.”  
CONFESSION ||| Hold his gaze, fingers trembling around the blade. ||| “I feel trapped between what I want and what you demand.”  
REVERSAL ||| Take a step forward, reclaiming the blade. ||| “I’ll decide how this unfolds — your questions, my answers.”  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, breath shaky, staring at the question in my hand. |||
